description: Abstract base class for command signal mappers in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It provides common functionalities for mapping commands to topic paths, handling supported actions, and generating exceptions for unknown commands. The class defines methods for constructing topic paths based on command type and channel, and for setting action types.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for specific command signal mappers, handling common logic for mapping commands to topic paths based on the command type and supported actions.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a TopicPath object based on the command and channel, utilizing a builder pattern.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a TopicPathBuilder for a specific command.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the actions supported by the command.

methods.name: setTopicPathAction
methods.description: Sets the action on the command's topic path builder based on the command's class name and supported actions.

methods.name: unknownCommandException
methods.description: Generates an exception for unknown commands, differing if the mapper is a response signal mapper.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the specific action on the builder based on the provided enum value.
